title: Creamy Chicken Crumble
description: A chicken casserole under a savoury crumble of breadcrumbs, parmesan and crushed Weet-Bix. It leans on packet soup and sauce sachets for the creaminess, which is where most of the flavour and all of the sodium comes from.

items.raw: 500 g raw skinless chicken breast diced

items.item: chicken and vegetable instant soup mix

items.raw: 4 tablespoons (60 g) Flora Light margarine melted

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 C fan forced.
Microwave the carrots and beans in a little water on high for 5 minutes.
Coat a large saucepan generously with cooking spray and saute the chicken with the garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the onion and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the creamed corn, soup mix, stock powder and parsley.
Blend the cheese sauce sachet with the cup of boiling water, add it to the pot and combine well.
Pour the filling into a large casserole or lasagne dish.
Combine all the crumble ingredients, using your hands to work it to a crumbled texture, and sprinkle it evenly over the filling.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the crumble is browned.

notes: The source offers two 425 g cans of tuna in spring water, drained, in place of the chicken.
Assembles a day ahead and bakes from the fridge, which is most of the appeal of a crumble like this. Add ten minutes if it goes in cold.
The crumble will not clump unless you use your hands. A spoon just moves it around.

nutrition.assumptions: Read off the printed panel, chicken column, which gives every field. Serving size of 250 g is worked out from the ingredient masses, roughly 1.79 kg losing about 15% in a 45 minute uncovered bake over six servings, since the page does not state it; the per-100 g column is derived from that. Packet soup, sauce sachet and stock powder brands vary, and they carry nearly all the sodium.
